testResults.name: strategy-sandbox-lint
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/strategy_lint -q
testResults.result: 44 tests passed: clean strategies pass and every prohibited pattern (wall-clock, sleep, network, subprocess, unseeded random, asyncio, concurrency, async syntax) has a failing fixture with an actionable file/line/rule diagnostic.

testResults.name: ci-wiring
testResults.result: The sandbox checker is wired into the repository suite through tests/strategy_lint and asserts the committed strategies tree lints clean, so it runs in CI with every pytest invocation.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; the checker parses ASTs only, never imports or executes strategy code, and has no clock, random, or network dependency.

decisions: Rules report at import site for whole-module rules and at each use for attribute rules; seeded generators remain legal.
lint_strategy dispatches over source text, paths, classes, and modules, and assert_sandbox_clean raises with a CI-ready rendered report.
